info.name: Triton One Customers Accounts Assets API

items.docs: Single JSON-RPC entrypoint accepting Metaplex DAS methods. Set the `method` field to one of getAsset, getAssets, getAssetProof, getAssetProofs, getAssetSignatures, getAssetsByAuthority, getAssetsByCreator, getAssetsByOwner, searchAssets, getNftEditions, getTokenAccounts, or getTokenLargestAccounts.
